logo.source: en.wikipedia.org infobox logo (Avery Dennison logo red.svg)

description: Avery Dennison is mostly a materials-science company: it coats paper, film and foil with adhesive and sells the rolls of self-adhesive label material to label converters, who print the labels for food, beverage, home and personal care, and logistics. It also makes vehicle-wrap and reflective films, tapes, and a growing line of RFID tags and apparel branding and price-ticket solutions sold to retailers and apparel brands. Materials Group is 69% of 2025 sales ($6.1B of $8.9B) and Solutions Group 31%. Its sub-industry is 'packaging' in the standard scheme, but the business is label materials and RFID item-identification rather than boxes or containers.
